prompts.name: core-p
prompts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: one premium desktop application logo concept for Pi App / Pith, an AI coding-agent desktop client.
Primary request: redesign the application logo with a completely solid saturated blue background and an expertly refined new internal symbol. Deliver ONE square 1024-by-1024 image, full-bleed flat royal blue #145BFF across the entire canvas edge-to-edge.
Style/medium: precise vector-like brand design rendered as a high-quality raster. Bold, deliberate geometry, clean curves, careful optical alignment, strong silhouette and generous margins. Professional desktop application identity, restrained, polished and memorable.
Composition/framing: symbol optically centered, occupying approximately 54–60 percent of the canvas; ample clear blue around it. Front-facing orthographic flat artwork.
Palette: solid uniform blue #145BFF background; primarily pure white #FFFFFF symbol, with pale ice blue #BFD9FF permitted ONLY for a small internal detail. The blue background must remain completely uniform.
Constraints: one mark only; no wordmark, no captions, no option labels, no typography other than the explicitly requested monogram. No presentation board or grid, no mockup, no device, no outer border, no floating app tile, no rounded outer corner, no transparency, no texture, no vignette, no gradients, no drop shadows, no glow, no photographic lighting. Refined does not mean adding tiny decorative detail. Must read clearly when reduced to an application icon.

Subject: CONCEPT A — CORE P. A custom capital P monogram that develops the current Pith identity of a P holding a small core. Design a substantial pure-white vertical stem and beautifully balanced rounded bowl, with a clean generous blue counter that contains one small pale-ice-blue circular core. The monogram should be contemporary rather than a font glyph: a gently squared top-left shoulder, precise circular right bowl, subtly softened flat foot, compact broad proportions. Counter and core must be intentionally sized so the core remains visible at 32 pixels. One solid P body plus one isolated small core, no extra notch or arrow. Visually balanced negative space, disciplined high contrast, crisp contours. The main mark should feel calm, capable, and distinctive.

Subject: CONCEPT B — PI BRIDGE. Invent a beautifully crafted pure-white Greek lowercase pi (π) monogram. It should be immediately readable as π but be entirely custom-drawn, with a bold sweeping horizontal upper bridge, a clean upright left leg, and a right leg that curls gently outward at its foot. Compact nearly square silhouette, broad load-bearing strokes, beautifully controlled transitions between rounded and straight geometry. A slightly extending left end on the upper bridge gives character; the right terminal and curled foot are optically balanced. Modern architectural simplicity, no italic font, no serif font, no equation, no extra dots, no sparkle. Use white only for the symbol. Carefully balance the internal blue opening and margins. It should feel like an original crafted software brand mark rather than a typeset mathematical character.

Subject: CONCEPT C — CODE CORE. An original abstract emblem for coding intelligence, formed by two bold mirrored inward-facing white angle-bracket shapes enclosing a single small pale-ice-blue diamond core. The brackets have chamfered exterior corners and softly refined inner corners. They almost form a compact open diamond silhouette but retain clear blue gaps at the top and bottom, so both code brackets and a protected central core are readable. The white left and right brackets are substantial, perfectly balanced, not thin outlines. The center core is a solid diamond with slightly softened tips and deliberate negative space all around. Make this feel like one considered brand emblem, not a stock </> icon and not a starburst. No slash, no extra circuit lines, no orbit ring, no enclosing square, no cube. Uniform clear gaps, polished geometry, distinctive app-sized silhouette.

Subject: CONCEPT D — FOLDED P. A distinctive capital P emblem built from one wide folded ribbon, with a diagonal top fold and a compact angular bowl. Pure white front face, one pale-ice-blue triangular fold plane, and open blue negative space form a precise paper-like P monogram. Strong vertical stem ending in a clean angled cut; upper loop built with controlled 45-degree folds and gently softened external corners. The open counter should be broad and simple. Show just two flat planes of the same ribbon; no gradients or shading, no overlapping extra objects. Avoid looking like a flag, a play button, or the Pinterest logo. The fold is a subtle geometric design decision inside a strong readable P silhouette. Crisp, elegant, more architectural and dynamic than a conventional rounded letter, with generous safe margins.
